## Installing

Copy `SCD3D11.dll` and `SCD3D11.ini` into your SimCity 4 `Plugins` folder, replacing the old DLL. Requires SimCity 4
Deluxe 1.1.641 for live shadows and the ReShade integration.

## What's new

* **Settings file.** `SCD3D11.ini` next to the DLL now holds every setting. A launch switch of the same name still
  works and overrides the file for that session, for example `-LiveShadows:on`. Values can be `on`/`off`,
  `enabled`/`disabled`, `true`/`false` or `1`/`0`. The log lists each setting and where it came from, and says when it
  ignored a value it could not use.
* **Live shadows in one setting.** `LiveShadows=on` replaces the `-NativeShadowMasks` modes. Buildings, trees, props,
  poles and prebuilt network pieces cast real shadows that fall on slopes, walls and each other, and hills shade the
  land behind them. Overlapping shadows no longer stack.
* **`NetworkShadowMasks`.** With live shadows on, the flat shadow masks of prebuilt network pieces are removed, because
  those pieces now cast their own shadows. Set `NetworkShadowMasks=on` to keep them.
* **New log location.** The log is now `Logs\SCD3D11.log` in your SimCity 4 folder, next to the logs of other plugins.
* **Debug symbols.** Each release now includes `SCD3D11.pdb`, so crash reports can be traced to the exact function.

## Faster

* Live shadows cost far less while scrolling. In a large city they went from about a third of each frame to about a
  tenth.
* The pauses of up to a third of a second that live shadows caused while scrolling are gone.
* Scrolling along the edge of the city no longer makes SC4 redraw the whole view on every frame.

## Fixed

* Shadows no longer darken the empty backdrop beyond the edge of the city.

## When upgrading

* Replace `-NativeShadowMasks:all`, `:props`, `:network` or `:replace` with `LiveShadows=on` in `SCD3D11.ini`, or
  `-LiveShadows:on` on the command line. The old switches no longer do anything.
* `-FullscreenMode:Borderless` is gone. Use `Borderless=on` or `-Borderless`.
* The log moved from `SC4D3D11.log` to `Logs\SCD3D11.log`.

## Known issues

* With ReShade, effects can stay off in the region view after leaving a city.
* `LiveShadows` still costs some frame rate, most of all while scrolling a large city.

## Reporting bugs

Found a problem? [Open an issue on GitHub](https://github.com/caspervg/scd3d11/issues/new/choose) and pick the bug
report template. It asks for your setup and for `Logs\SCD3D11.log` from the session that went wrong. If the game
crashed, paste its crash report as well.
